title: Enabling Private Access for a Group of Users

blocks.text: You can use Zscaler Service Entitlement to select which users can enroll into Zscaler Private Access (ZPA). Configuring Private Access using a small subset of users allows for testing before rolling out the service to all users.

To enable Private Access for only a select group of users, you must deploy Zscaler Client Connector 1.2.4 or later. However, earlier versions of Zscaler Client Connector always have Private Access enabled, regardless of the Zscaler Service Entitlement setting.

blocks.item: For Private Access instances created before July 2017, Private Access is enabled for all users by default. This preserves the existing behavior of Private Access enrollment prior to the addition of the selective entitlement feature.
For Private Access instances created after July 2017, Private Access is disabled by default. This allows you to determine when and how to provision Private Access for your users.

blocks.text: If you're using device groups, the user must belong to both the device group and user group to avoid disconnecting Private Access services. To learn more, see Creating Device Groups.

blocks.heading: Enabling Private Access for User Groups

blocks.text: To enable Private Access for a group of users:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Client Connector Entitlement > Private Access.

To enable Private Access for only a group of users, ensure that ZPA Enabled by Default for User Tunnel is disabled. If this setting is enabled, Private Access is available for all users and you cannot assign Private Access to a group.

Select a group of users from the drop-down menu, then click outside of the menu. By default, no user groups are selected, which indicates that no groups have access to Private Access. This allows users to keep their current settings.

blocks.text: These groups are defined in the Zscaler Admin Console. If you do not see your groups, ensure that groups were synced to the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. To learn more, see Syncing Directory Groups between Internet & SaaS and Zscaler Client Connector.

This updates your users' devices the next time they connect. If they are already connected, the devices automatically update in 60 minutes. To manually update their devices, users can go into Zscaler Client Connector and click Update Policy from the More window. After manually refreshing the device, they must reauthenticate on the Private Access page.
